items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining Ravens WRs.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee, per HC Kubiak; expected back Week 3.
items.why: Knee (meniscus), returned to practice Friday but doubtful.
items.opportunity: Full TE role for Michael Mayer.

items.text: Bills ruled out WR DJ Moore due to shoulder injury (AC joint sprain, day-to-day, chance next week).
items.why: Shoulder injury from TNF, not serious but OUT.
items.implication: Sit Moore; BUF WR targets shift.
items.opportunity: More looks for other Bills receivers.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury; Burrow said he would play.
items.implication: Monitor closely; likely plays but risk.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready to go. Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR, nice upcoming matchups.
items.why: Henderson: 'I’m ready to go.'; Brown IR creates need.
items.opportunity: Potential snap/carry share growth vs Stevenson.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester etc. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR. My Guy narrative brewing in Baltimore.
items.why: Flowers DNPs, Lane IR; hierarchy and My Guy note.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes/targets for Bateman et al.

items.text: Nico Collins hamstring history (missed 5 in 2024); routes last week 37/42 on Stroud dropbacks. MRI/DNP jeopardy.
items.why: High route share + hammy history + practice miss.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% target share on routes in W1; IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization W1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% tgt share last 10, 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util W1, 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC; out-routed Gainwell.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career vs Wentz; Bears D soft vs WRs.
items.why: High share + history with Wentz + matchup.
items.implication: Elite start even with backup QB.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, 69% pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), 0 RZ; SEA tough vs WRs.
